tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*/ /rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu/ /lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos/ /gus pa'i phyag gi yul
༄༅/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*/ /rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu/ /lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos/ /gus pa'i phyag gi yul

tei:div.tei:p: VENERABLE THRANGU RINPOCHEsngon brjod/

༄༅/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*//rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu//lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos//gus pa'i phyag gi yul du bsten//de yang gangs can bod kyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas brtsams da lta'i bar du/ mkhas btsun bzang grub kyi skyes bu khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas byung ba'i man ngag sna tshogs pa zhig ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rim byung rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te bstan bcos dang zhal gdams/ zin bris dang*/ cho ga /lo rgyus dang*/ rnam thar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ste bzhugs pa de dag bar lam dus kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mang po zhig chud zos su phyin pa ni bod phyi nang tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro yongs la gyong gun chen po zhig byung ste/ shin tu phangs pa'i gnas su 'gyur par ma zad/ da lta 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi skal par bzhugs pa dag las kyang*/ kha shas dpe rgyun dkon pas mi mngon pa'i dbyings su phebs la nye ba rnams mi nyams par dpe rgyun spel ba'i ched dang*/ yang phyag dpe shin tu mkho gal che ba khag /thos bsam dang nyams len gnang mkhan dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten de tsam med par spros med du bzhugs rgyur thugs mnyes pa rnams kyis stabs bde'i thog nas phyag dpe khag thob pa'i ched/ badzra bidyā yi dpe mdzod khang gis spar bskrun zhus dang zhu 'char bzhin/ da lam li thang spang phug gi mkhan po nges don gyis mdzad pa'i ¿chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung ¿zhes bya ba 'di nyid wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang nas 'gro gron btang ste deb grangs 1000 tham pa gsar du par skrun zhus pa lags te/ mdzad pa po ni/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal slob yin cing*/ 'jam mgon rnam thar zhal gsungs/

blo gros mtha' yas kyi byung ba brjod pa nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes pa las ches bsngags brjod gnang ba ni/ de nyid las/ ¿gzhan la bshad pa'i go chod pa ni/ spang phug bla ma nges don dang*/ lhag bsam rgyal mtshan gnyis yin/¿ zhes gsungs pa'i ya gyal de nyid yin la/ phyag dpe 'di nyid kyi zhu bsgrig 'gan 'khur ba dge slong tshe ring dang*/ thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug mkhan 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang*/ zhu dag pa bstan 'dzin shes rab dang*/ bkra shis phun tshogs bcas thams cad kyis phya ra gru 'degs gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu dang*/ ma 'ongs par phyag dpe gzigs mkhan rnams kyis dpe cha 'di'i steng nas bslab sbyang*/ zhib 'jug nyams len gang gzab kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yis don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong ba'i smon 'dun dang*/ de lta bu gnang rogs zhes kyang zhu ba lags/ de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang*/ zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyi lhag chad dang*/ nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi drung du bshags shing*/ nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug por stsol gnang bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ par skrun gleng brjod/ 'dir dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i rang lugs su mdo phyogs kyi gzhung chen bka' pod lnga ste/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ mngon pa mdzod bcas la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi srol rgyun dar tshul ni/ karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rje 'jig rten du byon pa nas nang brtag rgyud gsum zhes grags pa'i bshad bka' gtso bor mdzad de/ zab mo nang don gyi rtsa ba dang de'i rang 'grel/ brtag gnyis kyi rnam bshad dri med 'od dang*/

theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bsdus don bcas mdzad pa ma zad/ mdo phyogs la yang*/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me/ sher phyin skabs brgyad kyi stong thun/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i ṭī ka/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi rnam bshad/ mdo sde rgyan gyi bsdus don/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa dang bsdus don/ dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad sogs gsung 'bum pod sum cu lhag mdzad de/ 'chad nyan gyi sde rgya cher dar zhing*/ slob ma mkhas grub du ma 'byung ngo*//de nas karma pa bdun pa chos grags rgya mtshos dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa la slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa nyid bshad gzhir mdzad/ chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma sde bdun las/ rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rgyas pa rnam 'grel/ 'bring po rnam nges/ bsdus pa rigs thigs bcas gsum gyis dgongs pa 'grel ba'i tshul du bstan/ 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste rnam pa bzhis zur gyi dka' gnad rnams la spyi don dang*/ mtha' dpyod kyi tshul du bzhag /lha shāka rgyan sogs rgya gar gyi mkhas pa'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul tha dad pa rnams kyang ma 'dres par mdor bsdus te bkral ba tshad ma'i legs bshad kyi chu bo kun 'dus su bzhugs pa rigs gzhung rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bod gzhung gang la yang ma bltos par rang stobs kyis mdzad/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel chung don gsal dang sbyar te 'grel pa 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me zhes bya ba mdzad cing*/ 'di'i spyi don gyi skabs su mdo sde thams cad kyi dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag gtan la phab cing chos 'khor rim pa gsum zhes thams cad la grags pa yang nyan thos kyi skabs su 'khor lo dang po nyid kyi bzlas pa gsum la 'jog pa dang*/

gzungs dbang gi mdo'i dgongs pas gang zag gcig gi dri ma rags bar phra gsum sbyong ba'i ched du rim par gsungs pa dang*/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdor gdul bya tha dad pa gsum du gsungs pa sogs rnam par 'jog cing*/ spyir bstan gyis don gyi gtso bo rnams legs par bshad cing rgyas 'grel gdams ngag gi bar tsam duu grub pa zhig go /phar tshad 'di gnyis lta ba gzhan stong gtso cher bkral mod kyang sems tsam gyi lta ba la gzhan stong du ming btags pa bod kha cig gi 'dod pa ltar bkral ba ni ma yin la/ spyir rje 'di sems kyi gshis stong nyid gtso bor ston pa zab mo lta brgyud/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa rgya chen spyod brgyud ste sems kyi zab pa dang gsal ba ni gnyis su mi phyed pas na shing rta'i srol gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum gyi cho ga /gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i mngon rtogs la sogs pa bstan bcos khyad par ba gsung 'bum pod brgyad lhag mdzad/de'i slob ma rje btsun karma phrin las pas rje gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi don bsdus snang byed sgron me dang*/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rgyas 'grel 'jig rten gsum sgron gyi legs bshad dang sbyar te/ gzhung tshig mtha' dag don gyi sbyor ngag tu bkod pa mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi sbyor ṭīka 'jig rten gsum sgron la 'jug pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba'i mdo rtsa ba'i mchan 'grel mthong ba don 'grub gyi mchan gzhung dang bsres te/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i ṭīka chen mtsho sna dgongs rgyan mdzad/ ¿chos mngon pa mdzod kyi sbyor ṭīka ¿brtsams dus dbyig gnyen yin zer ba'i paṇḍi ta sngo sangs zhig gis dka' gnas dkrol ba rmis pa rnam thar las gsungs/

gzhan yang tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ 'byed rnam gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ brtag gnyis 'grel pa rang byung dgongs rgyan/ zab mo nang don la 'grel pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rtsis kun bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ do ha skor gsum gyi 'grel pa bsdus 'bring gnyis dang*/ rgyas pa rtsom 'phro sogs gsung 'bum pod bcu lhag mdzad de/ 'chad nyan gyis sgo nas bstan pa la mdzad rjes bla na med pa spel/ de nas karma pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rjes bshad sgrub kyi sdes dbus gtsang khams gsum du khyab par mdzad cing*/ dgung lo nyer gsum la sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭīka chen dang*/ dgung lo nyer gnyis nas nyer drug bar 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i ṭīka chen dang*/ dgung lo so dgu par dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel chen dang*/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la rje karma phrin las pa chen po las chos mngon pa mdzod kyi sbyor ṭīka gi bshad lung yongs su rdzogs par gsan te/ dgung lo nyer drug par mchims nam mkha' grags kyi ṭī ka dang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod rang 'grel gyi tshig don kun legs par bsdus nas ¿mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel chen grub bde'i dpyid 'jo ¿zhes bya ba pod chen gnyis mdzad pa ni/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ kho bo'i rjes su 'jug pa'i nyan thos dag la smras pa/ bdag gis chos mngon mdzod kyi sbyor ṭīka gi lung tsam zhig rje rin po che karma phrin las pa chen po'i zhal sngar rang lo nyer gnyis pa zhig la thos pas rkyen nas rang lo nyer drug par mchims nam mkha' grags kyi ṭī ka gzhir byas kyi dgongs pa btus nas gnas dang po dang gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis las/ snyoms 'jug dang po'i 'grel pa rgyas bsdus 'tshams par kong por sdod dus grub pa las/ kye ma dus kyi dbang gis 'grel pa byas kyang don gnyer can gyi skye bo mi 'byung bar dogs pa las/

slar dbus su phyin pa na bde bar gshegs pa chen po karma phrin las pa'i zhabs kyi bkas bskul ba la brten/ slar g.yas ru gtsang 'gram gyi lha khang dang nye ba/ hor sa skya pa yon mchod kyis gnas kyi pho brang du btab pa nyug rgyal khang du rang lo so gsum pa nas gnas gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis pa phyin gyi 'grel par bgyis pa la/ de phyin gyi gnas gnyis par sngar gyi gnas dang po dang gnyis pa'i 'grel pa gang zin las rgyas par 'grel zhing rang 'grel gyi don zhib cha phal mo che drangs te legs par bshad yod cing*/ gnas gnyis pa'i gsham tsam nas dka' tshegs la ma bsams par 'grel bshad gnyis kyi tshig sna bsrings te legs par bshad zin/¿ zhes bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su mdzod kyi 'grel pa zhig la 'di las rgyas pa gzhan med do snyam zhing*/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mngon pa mdzod kyi rgyas 'grel grub bde'i dpyid 'jo 'di nyid du rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos du ma rtsal du bton yod pas rmad du byung ba'i yon tan dang ldan zhing shin tu gal che ba yin te/ zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi don dbyig gnyen bzhed pa las/ ¿mngon pa'i mdzod ces grags pa'i bstan bcos 'dir/ /shes bya gzhi lnga sa lam yon tan sogs/ /brjod bya zab cing rgya che bzhugs pa la/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i 'grel byed mang na yang*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ¿dbyangs can zhabs ¿de yis/ /mchod brjod skabs su mchod yul ston pa dang*/ /dri ma'i skabs su sgrib gnyis dpyad pa dang*/ /gnyen pos nyes pa 'joms pa'i tshul lugs dang*/ /gzhung lam don dam mngon pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ /brtags dang brtags min 'gog pa nam mkha' dang*/ /phra rab rdul dang rig min mtshan nyid dang*/ /chos khams dbang po gtong thob 'du byed tshogs/ /rgyu lnga 'bras bu srid pa bar ma dang*/ /rten 'brel dus dang 'khor los bsgyur sogs dang*/

/so so thar dang de yi sdom pa dang*/ /de yi steng nas rnam rig yin min dang*/ /dus gsum sdom sogs skad cig ldan tshul dang*/ /bsnyen gnas nyid dang gtong rgyu thob rgyu dang*/ /las rnam bzhi dang bye brag myong 'gyur dang*/ /dri ma rgyas par 'gyur dang mi 'gyur ba/ /bden bzhi mthong sgom spang bya'i phra zhib dang*/ /zag pa chu sbyor kun sbyor bshad skabs dang*/ /gnyen po bzhi dang yongs su shes pa dang*/ /cig char rim gyis 'bras bu bar ma gnyis/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal sangs rgyas 'bras bu dang*/ /lam dang rten dang zhi lhag sa khams dang*/ /shes pa bcu dang bzhi po'i phra gsang dang*/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i yon tan dang*/ /snyoms 'jug rnams dang bye brag thod rgal sogs/ /de dag so so'i skabs su bod spyi yi/ /spyod yul las brgal 'bur dod mang du mdzad/ /rang 'grel gang spel rgyal sras ma la sogs/ /rgya 'grel bzhed pa'i gnas rnams gsal du gtod/ /ces gsungs shing*/ mdor na rje 'di'i gsung rtsom thams cad bsdu na sde tshan drug tu bsdus te/ dang po rang gzhan legs spyad sgrogs pa'i rnam thar dang rdo rje'i glu/ gnyis pa 'phrin yig bstod tshogs dris lan bslab bya dang smon lam/ gsum pa mdo sngags rnams kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i rgyas 'grel/ bzhi pa rdo rje sku yi go 'phang sbyin pa'i phyir cho ga sgrub thabs/ lnga pa sgyu 'phrul ting 'dzin mchog la sbyor bar byed pa'i mdo sngags khrid/ drug pa phyi nang rig gnas kun la bsnyengs pa bral ba'i thun mong rig gnas bcas gsung 'bum pod sum cu bzhugs/rje brgyad pa'i slob ma zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gis dgung lo nyer gsum pa la spyir las dang po pa dang*/ shes rab dman pa rnams sher phyin kar ṭīka chen mo rje btsun ngal gso la bslab pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur sher phyin rje btsun ngal gso'i tshig don thams cad nyung ngur bsdus te/

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba mdzad pa ste/ 'grel pa'i mdzad byang las/ gang tshe skom pas nyen pa'i sems can phra mo'i mdun du glo bur rgya mtsho lud gyur na/ /de tshe rab tu skrag cing 'thung ba'i spros pa nye bar zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ci/ /de bzhin yum don bde blag rtogs par 'dod pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /bla ma'i legs bshad zab rgyas mi rtogs de phyir bdag gis chu thigs lta bu 'di brtsams so/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang dbu ma snying po bsdus pa dang*/ sher phyin dgongs 'grel sogs gsung 'bum pod brgyad lhag mdzad/rje brgyad pa'i slob ma nyi ma lta bu dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa ṭīka chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char bar 'gyur ba'i skya rengs kyi snang ba zhes bya ba spyi don dang bsdus don rnam par bzhag pa/ dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye'i gzhi'i cho ga /gso sbyong gi cho ga /dus 'das 'byung ji ltar brjod pa/ dge slong gi sdom pa sbyin pa'i tshe dus brjod pa/ spyod 'jug shes le'i mchan 'grel/ rgyud bla ma'i mchan 'grel/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad cu'i bsdoms kyi mchan 'grel/ spyod 'jug rnam bshad theg chen chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs gsung 'bum pod bcu drug lhag mdzad/de nas rje zhwa dmar drug pas mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi don las/ de don nye bar bsdus nas bdag gi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen zhabs de yis rnam bshad bstsal/ /zhes pa gsungs pa ltar karma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rjes dgung lo bco brgyad par rje brgyad pa'i slob ma'i thu bo zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag las/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad lung yongs su rdzogs par gsan bsam gnang zhing*/ yongs 'dzin rnam rgyal grags pa la sogs pas mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa zhig mdzad dgos par bskul ma zhus te/

slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod rang 'grel dang*/ rgyal ba'i sras dang*/ gang spel la sogs pa 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ rje brgyad pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel chen grub bde dpyid 'jo'i legs bshad kun bsdus nas dgung lo nyi shu nas nyer gcig bar ¿mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad gzhon nu rnam rol ¿mdzad pa ni/ rje dgu pa'i zhal snga nas/ de nyid rang gi rnam par bshad pa dang*/ /sa bdag sras gyur grags pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /mkhas mchog gang ba spel sogs 'phags yul gyi/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad dang*/ /karma bka' brgyud grub pa'i shing rta che/ /grub bde dpyid 'jo zhes grags bstan bcos kyi/ /rnam par bshad pa'i cha kun legs bsdus nas/ /bdag gi rnam bshad gzhon nu rnam rol 'di/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam rgyal grags pa dang*/ /slob bu mdo rgyud rgya mtsho la sogs kyis/ /yang yang bskul nas rjes 'jug slob ma'i ched/ /'khyams po'i zer sgros rang bzo spangs te bshad/ /chos 'di bdag gis rang lo bco brgyad dus/ /dpal ldan bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /dkon mchog yan lag zhabs kyi spyan snga ru/ /drung mdzad rnam bshad steng nas chos mngon mdzod/ /bshad lung yongs su rdzogs pa legs par thob/ /phyi nas slob dpon chen por rtsa ba dang*/ /'grel pa 'grel bshad gnyis dang bcas pa la/ /dogs bcad dka' ba'i gnas la legs sbyangs nas/ /tshig don ma lus chub par bgyis pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang dgung lo nyer gsum nas nyer lnga bar dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa skal bzang dga' ston mdzad/ rje brgyad pa'i 'jug 'grel dwags brgyud grub shing gi sa bcad dang*/ tshad ma rigs gzhung snying po sogs gsung 'bum pod bcu lhag mdzad/de'i slob ma zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug ni/ gsung rab thams cad kyi glegs bam gcig pur gyur te/

rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ nor gyi rtsa lag 'dra ba'i mkhas gzhan med/ /mngon pa'i mdzod gzhung 'dra ba'i bstan bcos med/ /bdag gi mkhan po 'dra ba'i 'grel mdzad med/ /slar yang de gsal byed la nga 'dra med/ /ces gsungs te/ dgung lo nyer bzhi nas nyer bdun bar la/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mngon pa mdzod kyi rgyas 'grel grub bde dpyid 'jo dang*/ karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i mdzod kyi rnam bshad gzhon nu rnam rol gyi legs bshad snying po thams cad bsdus te/ ¿mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi don dbyig gnyen bzhed pa ¿zhes bya ba mdzad/ gzhung 'di'i rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi go rim ni gzhung gzhan dang mi 'dra ba thog mar 'grel pa dang de'i rjes su rtsa ba bkod yod pa dang*/ bod kyi bstan bcos ltar sa bcad sbyar med kyang rgya gzhung ltar gzhung snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor shin tu legs pa yod/ 'grel tshul yang sbyor ngag gtso bor bkod gnang 'dug pas/ las dang po pa rnams kyis go ba len bde zhing*/ nges shes skye sla ba bcas dge mtshan dang phan thogs shin tu che ba zhig yod/ gzhung gi dka' gnad gong 'og thams cad du rje brgyad pa dang dgu pa'i mdzod kyi ṭīka chen dang ṭīka chung gnyis kyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams 'dir lung 'dren du ma mdzad 'dug /mdor na gzhung 'di ni rje dgu pa'i mdzod 'grel gyi spyi don yin no/ /mdzod kyi spyi don 'di nyid mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi mdzad byang las/ de lta na yang deng sang rang lugs kyi/ /mtshan nyid smra bar grags pa phal mo ches/ /rnam bshad rnams kyi dgongs pa bor nas kyang*/ /sna tshogs yig sna rnams la blo rtse gtod/ /phar phyin skabs kyi zur bkol dge 'dun dang*/ /bsam gzugs spyi thal dum bu thor bu rer/ /lta rtog byas nas lam dang gang zag sogs/ /phar mngon gnyis ka'i dgongs pa rtogs par rlom/

/'chad nyan mkhan po so so so sos kyang*/ /gzhung dang rnam bshad dpang por mi byed par/ /ngag sgros 'khyar po'i dpe la brten nas kyang*/ /slar yang yig 'jog byed pa'i ngal ba rtsom/ /bu slob rnams kyang 'jam dbyangs 'di zhes pa'i/ /legs bshad yin zhes rgyal sde'i khrom la sgrog /rgyal dbang karma'i gsung rab sbyangs so lo/ /de tshe dpyod ldan skye dgus bltas pa'i tshe/ /ṭīkka'i phyogs snga gzung nas ṭīkka dang*/ /dgongs pa 'bur dod rnams kyi 'gal zla la/ /rang gzhung chen por brjod pa thos pa'i tshe/ /rjes su yi rang skye ba'i go skabs ci/ /des na gong du skabs don so so ba/ /smos pa rnams la sa bon tsam byas nas/ /karma'i rjes 'jug shes 'dod skye bo rnams/ /rnam bshad so sor 'chad nyan rtsal du thon/ /rgyal gsung dri med rnams kyi drung bshams na/ /bdag gi bshad pa blun po'i tshig tu snang*/ /sna tshogs bshad pa rnams dang go bsdur na/ /bdag gi brjod pa gzhung 'grel rnams la nye/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhung 'grel gzhan yang 'dul ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer dang*/ tshad ma'i spyi don/ dbu ma'i spyi don/ zab mo nang don gyi spyi don/ rgyud brtag gnyis kyi mchan 'grel/ bsdus grwa sogs gzhung 'grel du ma mdzad pa bka' brgyud gser phreng rnam thar du gsal/ sngar si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis gsan bsam yang*/ rje 'dis mdzad pa'i 'dul ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer dang*/ rgyud brtag gnyis kyi mchan 'grel dang*/ bsdus grwa'i steng nas gnang ba si tu'i rang rnam du gsal kyang*/ deng dus gong gsal phyag dpe rnams kyi dpe rgyun shin tu dkon rigs lta bu yin/ 'dul ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer 'di 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gis thabs shes yod dgu cog gnang ste/ rag thabs byed kyang da bar rag myong med/ si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sku tshe smad la 'brug yongs 'dzin rin po che mchog nas mngon pa mdzod kyi ṭī ka zhig mdzad dgos zhes bskul ma gnang ba ste/

ji skad du mdzod 'grel gyi mchod brjod las/ yongs 'dzin mchog gis bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ /rang nyid na tshod gtugs pas blo gros kyi/ /re kha nub pa'ang cung zad gsal bya'i phyir/ /chos mngon mdzod gzhung ci nus dbye bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod rang 'grel dang*/ slob dpon gyi slob ma mngon pa rang las mkhas pa blo brtan gyi thog gzer rgya dpe dngos steng nas sgra don gyi legs bshad tshig gi mtha' dpyad grub mthas ma bslad pa mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas bzhi pa'i dge ba'i las kyi mgo yan gyi ¿'grel chen brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu'i 'od snang ¿zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i rjes 'phros gnas phyi ma gzhan rnams be lo tshe dbang kun khyab kyis brtsams dgos pa si tu'i phyag lir bris yod na'ang be lo tshe dbang kun khyab kyis gnas bzhi pa'i mjug 'phros lus pa de nyid si tu'i gsung sgros dang bstun te kha skong brtsams gnang ba'i rjes/ gnas phyi ma bzhi po ni slob ma gzhan rnams kyis blo gros 'jal phyir brtsams ma gnang ba ste/ mdzod 'grel brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu'i 'od snang gi mdzad byang las/ de lta'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan bcos brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu'i 'od snang 'di'i gnas phyed bzhi rje bla ma'i gsung bris las par zhus lan gsum bcas yid ches pa'i zhus chen dang 'phros kyi 'grel pa ni rje yi phyag lir bdag gis brtsam dgos pa'i phyag bris gnang 'dug na'ang*/ rje de nyid kyi gsung ni rgya dpe dngos steng nas sgra don gyi legs bshad tshig gi mtha' dpyad grub mthas ma bslad pa de lta bu rang re bod kyis shes yul ma yin na'ang rgya dpe dngos 'grel rnams dang rje bla ma'i gsung sgros sogs dang bstun te gnas kyi kha skong bkod pa yin la/ rdzogs par bod 'grel gzhan las khyad thon tsam shes na'ang rje slob gzhan gyi blo gros 'jal phyir mi spro'o/

/zhes gsungs shing*/ gal te mdzod kyi 'grel chen 'di 'go nas mjug bar cha tshang rtsom bris gnang thub pa yin na dper na deng dus grags che ba'i sum rtags kyi 'grel chen lta bu si tu'i mdzod kyi 'grel chen zhes shin tu skad grags che ba zhig yong rgyu yin snyam/ spyir tshe dbang kun khyab kyis rje slob gzhan gyi blo gros 'jal phyir mi spro'o/ /zhes mdzod gnas phyi ma bzhi po'i kha skong 'grel pa ma mdzad par brten/ si tu paṇa chen gyi slob ma thugs sras dam pa gsum zhes 'brug yongs 'dzin sprul sku karma thub bstan ngag dbang dang*/ khams sprul rin po che chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ gcung tshab tsha sprul sku nges legs bstan 'dzin bcas las/ khams sprul chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ karma nges legs bstan 'dzin mchog nas mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa re re mdzad yod pa lo rgyus rnams su mjal bas phal cher si tu'i mdzod kyi 'grel chen rtsom 'phror lus pa de nyid kyi kha skong lta bu la mdzad pa yin nam snyam pa sems shing*/ khams sprul chos kyi nyi mas mngon pa mdzod si tu paṇa chen las gsan gnang ba yin tshul si tu'i rang rnam du gsal bas khams sprul gyi mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa de snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho lta bu si tu'i gsung sgros dang sbyar ba 'grel bshad mchog tu gyur pa zhig yod par nges shing*/ karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi mdzod 'grel sngar dpal spungs dgon du shing par bzhugs yod pa dpal spungs dgon pa'i lo rgyus rnams su mjal rgyu yod kyang*/ deng dus ni khams sprul dang nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi mdzod 'grel gnyis ka dpe rgyun shin tu dkon rigs su gyur te phyag dpe thob dka' bas mkhas pa sus bskul ma gnang ste mdzad pa dang*/ nang don brjod bya rgyas bsdus ji ltar yod pa/ si tu'i mdzod 'grel rtsom 'phros kyi kha skong yin min zhib cha shes pa shin tu dka' ba'i gnas su gyur lags/

de nas phyis su 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi slob ma li thang spang phug mkhan po karma nges don gyis si tu'i mdzod kyi 'grel chen skabs bzhi nas 'phror lus pa de nyid kyi kha skong lta bu la ¿mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung ¿zhes bya ba 'di nyid mdzad cing*/ phyag dpe 'di sngar dpal spungs dgon du shing par brkos myong yod pas bod du deng dus yang dpe rgyun re zung mjal rgyu yod pa dang*/ 'di ga rgya bal sogs phyi rgyal yul gru rnams su dpe rgyun thog mar spel gnang mkhan deb 'di'i ngo sprod gleng brjod du gsal ba ltar 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas phyi lo 2010 lor rgya gar gyi rgyal sa ldi lir deb gzugs su deb grangs gcig stong lhag par du bskrun te 'grems spel gnang yod pas dpe rgyun chad rgyu'i nyen kha las thar/'brug pa kun mkhyen padma dkar pos chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa 'grel pa lugs dang*/ chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa rje btsun byams pa'i zhal lung dang*/ tshad ma mdo dang sde bdun gyi gtan la phab pa'i bstan bcos rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan/ tshad ma'i mdo sde bdun dang bcas pa'i spyi don rigs pa'i snying po/ sdom gsum gyi snying po bstan pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan ces bya ba'i bstan bcos/ sdom gsum rgyan la phyis su rje dge 'dun rin chen gyis mchan 'grel pad dkar zhal lung dang*/ rje a dbyangs kyis mchan 'grel shin tu bsdus pa bcas mdzad yod/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan ces bya ba ba'i rgya cher 'grel/ 'di ni bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su sdom gsum gzhung rgyas shos shig yin/ spyod 'jug 'bru 'grel dbu ma'i lam gyi sgron ma/ dbu ma yang dag par brjod pa/ de'i 'grel pa dbu ma'i gzhung gsum gsal byed nges don grub pa'i shing rta sogs gsung 'bum pod nyer bzhi mdzad/

khams sprul bdun pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyis mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin dang*/ mngon pa mdzod kyi bsdus don bcas mdzad/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gis rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mngon pa mdzod kyi kar ṭīka grub bde'i dpyid 'jo 'di nyid sngar bshad khrid kyis 'bad rtsol gnang skabs rgyas drags pa lta bus gsar bu ba rnams ha las pa lta bu'i myong tshor zhig byung ste/ dang por 'grel pa bsdus pa tsam zhig bslab/ de nas rgyas 'grel la 'jug na phan thogs che bar dgongs te/ mngon pa mdzod kyi kar ṭīka grub bde'i dpyid 'jo'i tshig don kun legs par bsdus pa las dang po pa rnams kyis bltas na go ba len bde zhing*/ nges shes skye sla ba bcas yod pa ¿mdzod kyi 'grel chung las dang po'i 'jug ngogs grub bde'i bcud bsdus ¿zhes bya ba mdzad pa la sogs pa gna' deng gi mkhas dbang rnams kyis mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa du ma mdzad de/ deng sang bar du dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i bshad sde rnams su mngon pa mdzod kyi 'chad nyan gyi srol rgyun rnams ma nub par legs par bzhugs so//mdor na gong gsal mdzod 'grel rnams las 'grel pa ¿rgyas shos ¿ni rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi mdzod kyi 'grel chen grub bde'i dpyid 'jo zhes pa'i pod chen gnyis po de yin/ ¿'bring po ¿si tu paṇa chen gyi mdzod 'grel brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu'i 'od snang dang*/ 'di gnyis las cung zad ¿bsdus pa ¿rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i mdzod kyi rnam bshad gzhon nu rnam rol zhes pa de yin/ mdzod 'grel 'di'i nang rtsa ba la sa bcad zhib mor bris yod pa dang*/ dgag bzhag spong gsum gyi rnam gzhag med pa rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel mthar chags su yod pas las dang po pa rnams kyis slob sbyong gnang skabs med du mi rung ba'i 'grel pa zhig yin/

gzhan zhwa dmar drug pa dang*/ karma nges don dang*/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gi mdzod 'grel rnams ni 'grel pa rgyas bsdus shin tu 'tshams po yod/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa lugs zhes pa de tshig don gnyis kar shin tu bsdus pa zhig yin/ rje karma phrin las dang*/ karma nges legs bstan 'dzin dang*/ khams sprul bzhi pa dang bdun pa'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa de rnams phyag dpe dngos su mjal rgyu ma byung bas rgyas bsdus ji ltar bzhugs yod pa ma rtogs so//de ltar gong gsal mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum mang du bzhugs pa las/ da lam 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi slob ma li thang spang phug mkhan po karma nges don gyis mdzad pa'i ¿mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung ¿zhes bya ba 'di nyid sngar dpal spungs dgon du shing par bzhugs yod kyang*/ 'di ga rgya bal sogs su dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pas/ gang myur par skrun ma byas phyin bstan bcos 'di nyid rtsa stong 'gro nyen yod pa la brten/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas thabs 'tshol gnang ba'i dpal spungs dgon gyi shing par gyi ma dpe de nyid chad lhag med par 'jam dbyangs bkra shis lags nas glog klad nang du bcug pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin shes rab dang bkra shis phun tshogs bcas kyis ma dpe dang chad lhag med par zhu dag btang ste/ wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang gis 'gro gron cha tshang btang nas deb grangs 1000 tham pa gsar du par bskrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags/ spyir mdzod 'grel 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'ga' zhig mngon te/ mdzad pa pos gzhung du rtsa 'grel mnyam sbyar gnang yod pas rtsa ba de'i 'grel pa dang 'grel pa de'i rtsa ba gang yin ngos 'dzin sla ba yod pa dang gcig

/rtsa ba la sa bcad shin tu rgyas spros dang bsdus skyon med pa sa bcad rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa yod pa dang gnyis/ dgag bzhag spong gsum gyi rgyas spros med pa rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel mthar chags su yod pa dang gsum/ gzhung gi tshig don gnyis kar las dang po pas bltas na shes sla ba dang go bde ba bcas yod pa dang bzhi'o// 'grel pa mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus ni/ yul dus kyis rkyen pas skabs 'bab rnyed son ma byung kyang*/ spyir rje 'di nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang*/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ byams pa phun tshogs sogs gsar rnying ris med kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yi bdag nyid du gyur te/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'di nyid kyang dpal spungs sgrub grwar mdzad gnang ba yin pa ni/ mdzod 'grel 'di nyid kyi mdzad byang las/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' yi gnang bas dbugs 'byin pa dang*/ chos kyi spyan can gzhan dag gis kyang legs so'i gzengs bstod cing*/ khyad par du 'jam mgon gong mas rgya dpe'i steng nas bsgyur bshad gnang ba brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu'i 'od snang zhes legs bshad kyi gter chen po zhig stsal ba kha skong bcas skabs bzhi nas 'phror lus pa/ de nyid kyi zhabs 'degs su'ang 'gyur bar bsams nas/ thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi nyin mor byed pa 'jam mgon bla ma zhal rnam pa gnyis dang*/ rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa phun tshogs sogs chos bzhin du spyod pa'i gsar rnying ris med kyi yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor thob pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba dpal karma pa chen po'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i rgyal khams pa karma nges don chos kyi nyi ma'am/ gsung rab phreng ba bdud rtsi'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya bas bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi sgrub grwar don 'grub ces pas lug lo'i smin drug can gyi gral tshes bzang por rdzogs par sbyar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ spyir 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas mchog la slob ma mkhas pa gzhan la bshad pa'i go chod pa'i slob ma gnyis yod pa'i/ slob ma gcig ni mdzod 'grel mdzad pa po rje 'di nyid yin pa dang*/ cig shos ni sum rtags 'grel pa legs bshad snang ba dam pa'i mdzad pa po lhag bsam bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes pa de yin no//rje 'di'i gsung rtsom kyang kho bo'i mthong thos kyi spyod yul du gyur pa rnams ni/ sdom gsum snying bsdus dang*/ de'i bsdus don sa bcad/ sdom gsum rnam nges kyi 'grel pa 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i zhal lung dang*/ sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig don gyi cha legs par rnam par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba dang*/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung bcas yin no//gzhan yang rje 'dis 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i spyi lo 1862 lor sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos shig mdzad dgos par skul ma zhus skabs/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi dgongs par bstan bcos shig bris na sdom gsum tsam ma yin par shes bya'i rnam gzhag cha tshang ba zhig yod na phan thogs che bar gzigs nas bslab pa gsum gyi bstan bcos shes bya kun khyab ces pa'i rtsa ba mdzad/ de nyid 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang por gzigs phul skabs/ 'di ni nges par bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ mkha' 'gros rtsa sgo phyes pa'i stobs las byung ba yin 'dug pas/

mdzod chen rnam pa lnga'i thog mar shes bya mdzod du bzhag nas de la rang 'grel zhig kyang mdzad dgos pa'i bka' gnang ste phyis su rang 'grel kyang mdzad de mdzod chen lnga'i thog mar bzhag gnang ba yin no/ /des na mdzod chen lnga'i dang po ¿shes bya kun khyab mdzod ¿ni rje 'di nyid kyis skul ma gnang ba la brten nas byung ba lags so//zhes bal bod kyi sa mtshams/ shar sba khang don grub sdings kyi btsun pa tshe ring shar pas/ deb 'di'i ngo sprod gleng brjod du dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i phyogs su spyir gzhung chen bka' pod lnga'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi srol rgyun dar tshul dang*/ bye brag tu mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa byung rim gyi rnam gzhag las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam 'di yang 'phags yul grong khyer chen po wā rā ṇa sī'i nye 'dabs su gnas pa'i badzra bidyā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du phyi lo 2010 zla 7 tshes 25 nyin sbyar ba'o//dkar chag

ka sngon brjod/ iii kha par skrun gleng brjod/ ix ga gzhung dngos gzhi/gnas dang po/ khams bstan pa/ 3 gnas gnyis pa/ dbang po bstan pa/ 49 gnas gsum pa/ 'jig rten bstan pa/ 107 gnas bzhi pa/ las bstan pa/ 169 gnas lnga pa/ phra rgyas bstan pa/ 241 gnas drug pa/ lam dang gang zag bstan pa/ 279 gnas bdun pa/ ye shes bstan pa/ 327 gnas brgyad pa/ snyoms 'jug bstan pa/ 361 nga gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi sa bcad/gnas dang po/ khams bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 391 gnas gnyis pa/ dbang po bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 398 gnas gsum pa/ 'jig rten bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 406 gnas bzhi pa/ las bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 416 gnas lnga pa/ phra rgyas bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 426 gnas drug pa/ lam dang gang zag bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 430 gnas bdun pa/ ye shes bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 436 gnas brgyad pa/ snyoms 'jug bstan pa'i sa bcad/ 439 ༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa dbyig gnyen zhal lung zhes bya ba/ bsod nams ye shes chu rdul tshad med zab gsal stong pa'i mkha' la dkrig/mkhyen dang brtse ba'i gzi brjid rab 'phro glog gi sgron mas mun pa bsreg/snyan grags rnga sgras skye dgu'i rna ba dge bar sgrub byed thub dbang gtso//dam chos char gyis gdul bya gsher mdzad khyed la 'dud do dge legs stsol//srid pa'i tshang tshing zag pa'i sa bon dang bcas pa//drung nas 'byin cing ma mo'i sde snod mchis so 'tshal//sdud pa'i mthu thob bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab can//shā ri'i bu sogs dgra bcom tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal//gcig gis dman pa'i gsung rab 'bum sde brgya//ma lus spobs pas bzung ba'i mgrin pa nas//bstan bcos gzhung brgya spro ba dbyig gi gnyen//khyod las 'gran zla gnyis pa srid 'dir dben//'dzam gling 'di na dam chos mngon pa'i bstan//mi nub 'dzin spel lhur bzhes blo brtan dang*//dzi na mi tra ska cog mchims sogs kyi//bka' drin nyin mo'i snang ba yang yang dran//rgyal ba'i zhal gyi padma'i tshal ma lus//lung rigs 'od snang gcig gis bzhad nus pa//dbyangs can dga' ba dbang phyug rdo rje'i mtshan//chos kyi snang ba thub bstan mdzes pa'i gnyen//brtan pa'i 'khor los thugs ka brgyan pa la//ngur smrig gos kyis sbas kyang ma sgrib par//sgra chen smra ba'i seng ge byams pa'i mtshan//byang chub bar gyi lam mkhan khyod nyid 'tshol//gangs can mkhas pa mang po'i rnam dpyod kyi//'grel bshad nor bu'i snye ma bdal zin na//bdag blo'i spobs pa sbun pa'i dngos po bzhin//mkhas rnams dgyes pa bskyed 'os lta ci zhig/'on te rang blo goms par bya ba dang*//'jam mgon bla ma'i bka' yis dbugs dbyung phyir//chos mngon padmo'i mdzod kyi kha 'byed pa'i//legs bshad dbyig gnyen zhal lung 'di na spro//de'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa lta bu'i bka' drin can/

rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa'i me tog yang yang 'thor te/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /lho yi phyogs su bram ze ni//yi ge'i dang po ba bstan pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan la de gtso byed//ces sogs dang*/ khyad par 'dzam gling 'di na mngon par mtho ba rgyan drug tu grags pa'i nang tshan rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i mdzod 'di 'chad pa la don bzhi ste/ mtshan don/ 'gyur phyag /gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ a bhi dharma koṣā' kā' rī kā/ bod skad du/ chos mngon pa'i mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ zhes sogs ste/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa gang zhig /de las legs par sbyar ba'i skad du na a bhi dharma koṣā' kā' ri kā /dgos pa ni chos khungs mar mtshon pa dang*/ skad la bag chags 'jog pa dang*/ rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i ched du yin ces dam pa snga ma rnams bzhed/ bod skad du a bhi dharma chos mngon pa/ koṣā mdzod/ kāri kā tshig le'ur byas pa'o//gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa ste/ nyes pa'i rtsub reg thams cad dang bral bas 'jam pa dang*/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang ldan zhing*/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod du gyur pa'i dus bzhin gzungs dang spobs pa'i blo gros nam yang rgud pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i ched du lo tsā bas bstan bcos 'di bsgyur ba'i thog mar phyag mdzad pa'o/ /'di'ang mngon pa'i sde snod ngos 'dzin pa'i ched du yin gsungs pa don la gnas/ gsum pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ bstan bcos brtsam pa'i bya ba/ brtsam bya'i bstan bcos dngos/

brtsam pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan don/ bstan bcos kyi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing*//'khor ba'i 'dam las 'gro ba drangs mdzad pa//don bzhin ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas//zhes pa ste/ phyag 'tshal ces sngon du drangs nas/ gang la na/ gang zhig ste spyi'i sgra de bye brag tu ston pa bcom ldan 'das dang 'brel pas de la'o//de'ang don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa ste skye mched bcu gnyis sogs shes bya kun la nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa'i mun pa gtan nas bcom pa ste rang don phun tshogs dang*/ gang spel gyis kun la zhes pas spangs pa dang*/ gtan nas zhes pas rtogs pa phun tshogs bstan par bzhed/ dam pa dag spangs pa dngos su bstan nas rtogs pa shugs la bstan te/ spangs pa la ye shes 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan don phun tshogs ni/ zag bcas kyi phung po lnga yi rgyun skye 'chis rgyud mar 'khor ba brgal bar dka' bas 'dam rdzab dang chos mthun pa'i sdug bsngal gsum las/ der bying ba'i 'gro ba skyabs med pa rnams dam pa'i chos ston pa'i phyag brkyangs te drangs par mdzad pa yin gyi/ rdzu 'phrul dang dam pa sbyin pa'i mthus ma yin te/ chos ji ltar ston na rang rang gi khams dbang bsam pa sogs skal pa dang 'tshams par blang dor gyi don phyin ci ma log pa ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa ste/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen po ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes dang*/ 'di skabs kyi mun pa ni chos mthun pa'i phyir sgrib pa la mun pa'i ming gis btags pa'o/ /nyon mongs can gyi mun pa gtso bo thar pa la sgrib byed srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug mtshungs ldan thob pa dang bcas pa dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa gtso bo thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'gal zlar byed pa mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi sogs sems byung rmongs pa zhig ste/

'grel par/ ¿'di ltar de dag la sangs rgyas kyi chos dang yul dang*/ dus shin tu bskal pa dang*/ don rab tu dbye ba mtha' yas pa rnams la nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa yod pa nyid do//¿zhes dang*/ de la sangs rgyas kyi chos zab cing phra bas mi shes pa ni/ ston pas shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po sogs shes sam gsungs pa na/ gsol pa de ni ma 'tshal to zhes dang*/ yul shin tu bskal bas mi shes pa mauṅgal gyi bus rang gi ma byang phyogs 'od zer can du skyes pa ma shes pa dang*/ dus shin tu bskal bas mi shes pa shā' ri'i bus khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod par ma mthong nas rab tu ma byung ba dang*/ ston pas/ ngas ni 'di yi thar pa yi/ /sa bon shin tu phra ba dag//tshon nam rdo yi gseb na gser/ /bag la zha ba'i tshul du gzigs//zhes gsungs nas rab tu byung ba dang*/ don gyi rab tu dbye ba mtha' yas pas mi shes pa khams dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ skye gnas dang*/ skye ba sogs kyi bye brag rtogs dka' ba rnams te/ sgra gcan zin gyis/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu ni/ /rgyu yi dbye ba sna tshogs pa//kun mkhyen min pas shes bya min/ /de mkhyen pas na kun mkhyen stobs//zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'dis ni nyan rang las spangs pa khyad par du 'phags pa bstan to//'o na nyan rang sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed pa ma yin par thal/ mdo las/ ¿nga ni chos gcig mngon par mi shes shing yongs su ma shes par sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par mi smra'o ¿zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'grel par/ ¿nyon mongs can gyi rmongs pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ kun la mun pa bcom pa ni 'dod mod kyi gtan nas ni ma yin te/¿ zhes dang*/ des na nyan rang la mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi yod pa dang*/ ston pas gnyen po brnyes nas phyis mi skye ba'i chos can du gyur pas gtan nas bcom par 'dod do/

/ston pas chos gcig mngon par mi shes par gsungs pa ni sdug bsngal bden pa ma rtogs na sdug bsngal gyi mthar mi byed pa la dgongs pa yin/ nas ni tshig phyi ma 'dren pa'o//gnyis pa brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos rab bshad bya// ¿1¿ zhes pa ste/ sde bdun sogs kyi tshig don rgyas pa rnams chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan bcos 'dir nyung ngu'i ngag gis rab tu bshad par bya'o//gsum pa bstan bcos kyi mtshan don ni/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas//de thob bya phyir gang dang bstan bcos gang*//'dir de don du yang dag chud phyir ram//'di yi gnas de yin pas chos mngon mdzod// ¿2¿ ces pa ste/ chos mngon pa la/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang*/ brdar btags pa'o/ /de la don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ni/ lam gsum gyi mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor gyur pa bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab zag bcas kyi dri ma med pa rjes 'brang phung po lnga dang bcas pa'o//de'ang mthong lam ni phung po lnga pa 'ba' zhig dang*/ lam phyi ma gnyis khams 'og ma gnyis la brten na phung po lnga pa dang*/ gzugs med la brten na phung po bzhi pa can du 'dod/ brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa la/ lam mngon pa dang*/ gzhung mngon pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa de thob par bya ba'i phyir bdag med pa'i don 'ol spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i skyes sbyor gyi shes rab zag bcas gtso bor nyan thos tshogs sbyor ba'i rgyud na yod pa gang dang*/ gnyis pa gzhung mngon pa ni/ brjod bya chos mngon pa'i don de rjod byed kyi bstan bcos gang zhig /ye shes la 'jug pa sogs 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ yang ci'i phyir 'di la mdzod ces bya zhe na/ bstan bcos 'dir mngon pa sde bdun po de tshig gi sgo nas ma yin par don gces gces rnams don du yang dag par chud pa'i phyir ram/ yang na bstan bcos 'di gang las btus pa'i gzhi'am gnas ni mngon pa sde bdun de yin pas chos mngon pa'i mdzod ces bya'o//dper na ral gri gang du 'jug pa dang*/

gang las byung ba de la de'i shubs zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ snga ma ltar na mdzod dang*/ phyi ma ltar na mdzod can zhes bsgyur na go bde bar 'jam mgon gong mas bzhed/ bzhi pa bstan bcos kyi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ chos rnams rab tu rnam 'byed med par nyon mongs rnams//gang phyir nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med la/nyon mongs pas kyang 'jig rten srid mtsho 'dir 'khyams te//de bas de phyir 'di ni ston pas gsungs so lo// ¿3¿ zhes pa ste/ chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid rab tu rnam par 'byed pa ni shes rab med par nyon mongs pa rnams spong mi nus te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na shes rab de ma gtogs nyon mongs pa rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs gzhan med la/ gal te nyon mongs pa ma zhi na cir 'gyur snyam na/ nyon mongs pa ni srid pa'i rtsa ba yin pas/ des kyang las bsags te 'jig rten srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po zab cing brgal dka' ba 'dir skye ba yang dang yang du len nas brtsams par 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan de bas na thar pa thob pa'i thabs chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab de thob par bya ba'i phyir du chos mngon pa'i sde snod 'di ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so//lo zhes pa ni 'di ni chos mngon pa pa'i lugs yin gyi/ mdo sde pa kho bo cag gi ni ma yin no zhes pha rol gyi 'dod pa ston pa'i phyir dang*/ ston pas chos mngon pa 'di ji ltar gsungs na/ bye smras ¿yul dang gang zag sna tshogs la 'thor bur gsungs pa rnams dgra bcom pa bdun gyis bsdus so/ /dper na ched du brjod pa'i tshoms btsun pa chos skyobs kyis bsdus pa bzhin no/ /ston pas mngon pa ma bstan na shā ri'i bu la sogs pas chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed mi nus pa dang*/ sde snod gsum ma tshang ba dang*/ 'od srung gis mngon pa bsdus par bshad pa'ang don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro ¿zhes zer/

slob dpon gyis mdzod rtsom pa'i dgos pa'ang 'dis bstan te/ zag bcas zag med kyi chos rnams brjod bya/ de rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bstan bcos 'di la brten nas bde blag tu skye ba ni dgos pa/ shes rab des myang 'das thob pa nying dgos/ snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma dang 'brel pa ni 'brel pa'o//de'ang gzhung tshig chos rnams zhes pas brjod bya/ rab tu rnam 'byed ces pas dgos pa/ med par zhes pa nas bzlog pa'i sgo nas nying dgos dang*/ 'brel pa ni de'i shugs kyis bstan par 'dod do/ /sde bdun ni/ ye shes la 'jug ka tya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis//rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus//gdags pa'i bstan bcos mauṅgal bus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches//khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos bsdus/ /zhes dang*/ gang spel gyis/ 'gro ba'i rnam grangs shā ri'i bus/ /zhes so//gnyis pa brtsam bya'i bstan bcos dngos la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas brgyad du grangs nges pa ci zhe na/ zag bcas zag med spyir bstan pa'i phyir gnas dang po gnyis dang*/ zag bcas bye brag tu ston pa'i phyir gnas bar pa gsum ste/ de'ang kun nas nyon mongs pa sems can gyi 'jig rten dang*/ gang du kun nas nyon mongs pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ ji ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa skye gnas bzhi dang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis ston pa gnas gsum pa dang*/ gang gis kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa'i zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa ston pa'i phyir gnas bzhi pa dang lnga pa/ zag med bye brag tu ston pa la gnas phyi ma gsum ste/ rnam par byang ba de gang na gang zag dang*/ gang du na khams gsum dang*/ ji ltar na mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ste gnas drug pa dang*/ gang gis na ye shes kyis te gnas bdun pa dang*/ yon tan de rnams kyi rten bstan pa'i phyir gnas brgyad pa bstan to/

/zhes 'chad/ de dag gi go rim gyi 'brel ni gnas so so'i skabs su rtogs par bya'o//gnyis pa gzhung don dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ lus mdor bstan pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams//zhes pa ste/ 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bo rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i chos de gang zhe na/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'i chos rnams so zhes mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o//gzhan yang 'dus byas ma byas dang*/ gzugs can yin min sogs kyi dbye bas mi bstan pa ci zhe na/ de dag gis kun byang gi phyogs so sor dbye mi nus pas des na gtso bo de dag so sor dbye ba'i phyir/ zag pa yod med gnyis su bsdus te bstan pa'o//gnyis pa bshad pa la gnyis/ zag bcas bshad pa/ zag med bshad pa'o/ /

dang po ni/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams//zag bcas gang phyir de dag la/ /zag rnams kun tu rgyas par 'gyur// ¿4¿ zhes pa ste/ lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams zag bcas kyi mtshan gzhi yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na chos de dag la dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas zag pa ste nyon mongs rnams kun tu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lam bden ces pas 'jig rten pa'i lam las bkar ba dang*/ zag bcas zhes pas dgra bcom pas spangs pa'i zag pa tsam la des ma khyab par bye smra rang lugs la 'dod pa yang bzhed/ gnyis pa zag med bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ 'dus ma byas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ zag med lam gyi bden pa dang*/ /'dus ma byas rnam gsum yang ste//nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis//zhes pa ste/ zag med kyi mtshan gzhi 'dus byas lam gyi bden pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas rnam pa gsum yin no/ /yang ste zhes pa nges bzung gi don te/ 'ga' zhig gis 'dus ma byas myang 'das 'ba' zhig dang*/ la las rdul phra rab sogs mang por 'dod pa rnams bcad pa'i phyir smos so/ /rnam pa gsum ni nam mkha' dang ni so sor brtags pas 'gog pa dang*/ brtags min gyis 'gog pa gnyis dang gsum du bzung ngo*/ /mtshan nyid ni sngar bshad pa de nyid bzlog pa ste/ gang phyir de dag la/ zag rnams kun tu rgyas min pa'o/ /zhes pas rtogs pa nyid do//gnyis pa 'dus ma byas bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtags 'gog /brtags min 'gog bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de la nam mkha' mi sgrib pa'o// ¿5¿ zhes pa ste/ 'dus ma byas gsum po de la nam mkha' ni dngos po gang zhig /mi sgrib pa'i mtshan nyid can te/ gzugs can skye ba'i go 'byed pa dang*/ rang yang gzugs can de nyid kyi go sar tha mi dad pa'i tshul du yod pa'o//gnyis pa so sor brtags 'gog ni/ so sor brtags pas 'gog pa gang*/

/bral ba'o so so so so yin//ces pa ste/ sdug bsngal sogs 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la shes rab kyis so sor brtags pas bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngo skal gyis thob pa'i 'gog pa gang zhig /ngo bo ni/ spang bya zag bcas kyi chos rnams dang bral ba'o//'gog pa de gcig gam tha dad ce na/ spang bya ris lnga ldan pa'i rdzas kyang so sor tha dad pa bzhin du bral ba'i rdzas 'gog pa rnams kyang so sor tha dad pa yin no//gsum pa brtags min 'gog bshad pa ni/ skye la gtan du gegs byed pa//'gog gzhan so sor brtags min pas// ¿6¿ zhes pa ste/ dgag bya 'dus byas ma 'ongs pa skye ba la gtan du gegs byed pa/ bshad ma thag pa'i 'gog pa las gzhan du gyur pa shes rab kyis so sor brtags pa min par rkyen ma tshang ba'i stobs kyis 'thob pa/ dper na/ mig shes gzugs gzhan la g.yeng ba na bya rog 'dzin pa'i shes pa mi skye la/ de skyes pa'i tshe bya rog phyogs gzhan du song nas de mthong ba'i shes pa de ma 'ongs mi skye ba'i chos can du song ba lta bu 'dod/ don du rnam shes da lta ba la rkyen gzhan tshang yang mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen ma tshang bas don gzhan la dmigs pa'i shes pa mi skye ba dang*/ slar 'das zin pa na rkyen gzhan tshang yang dmigs rkyen ma tshang ba'i phyir ro//de'ang skye la zhes pas mi rtag pa'i 'gog pa dang*/ gtan du zhes pas snyoms 'jug gnyis kyi 'gog pa dang*/ gzhan ces pas so sor brtags 'gog rnams bcad par bshad/ de dag gi don ni/ mi rtag pas gnas pa la gegs byed pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug gnyis kyis sems sems byung re zhig tsam mi skye bar byed pa dang*/ brtags 'gog ni shes rab kyis so sor brtags nas 'gog par 'gyur ba yin no//gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ 'dus byas kyi rnam bzhag /phung khams skye mched kyi rnam bzhag /chos gsum gyis thams cad bsdus par bstan pa/

khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan gzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs/ zag bcas kyi rnam grangs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dus byas chos rnams de dag kyang*/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga//zhes pa ste/ gong du/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zhes pa'i lam dang bcas pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos de dag gi mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ rgyu rkyen rnams 'phrad cing 'dus nas byas pa'i chos rnams yin te/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na gzugs dang*/ la sogs pas tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam shes kyi phung po dang lnga'o//gnyis pa ming gi rnam grangs ni/ de dag nyid dus gtam gzhi dang*/ /nges par 'byung bcas gzhi dang bcas// ¿7¿ zhes pa ste/ 'dus byas de dag nyid la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan dus zhes bya ste/ sngar song zin pa dang*/ 'gro bzhin pa dang*/ 'gro bar 'gyur bas sam/ yang na mi rtag pas za zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gtam gyi gzhi zhes kyang 'dod de/ gtam ni lung du ston pa'i ngag dang*/ de'i gzhi ni don dang bcas pa'i ming 'dus byas rnams ngag gi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'o na 'dus ma byas la mi 'dod pa ci zhe na/ 'dus ma byas gtam gyi rgyu ma yin pa dang*/ brjod bya nyung ba'i phyir gtam gyi gzhi ma bstan to zhes so/ /nges par 'byung ba dang bcas pa ste/ gang las nges par 'byung ba'i gzhi 'dus byas yin pas de las 'das na lhag med kyi myang 'das thob pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhi dang bcas pa ni gzhi'i sgra rgyu la 'jug pas 'dus byas rnams rgyu de la rag las pa'am/ yang na 'dus byas 'di la 'gog pa sogs kyi 'bras bu gnas pa'i phyir gzhi zhes brjod ces blo brtan gyis bshad/ gsum pa zag bcas kyi rnam grangs bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung po'ang de dag 'thab bcas kyang*//sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang*/

/lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin// ¿8¿ ces pa ste/ 'dus byas de dag las gang dag zag bcas su bshad pa rnams la nye bar len pa'i phung po zhes brjod de/ nye bar len pa'i nyon mongs pa yin la/ zag bcas kyi phung po rnams de las byung ba'i phyir/ rtsa las byung ba'i me la rtsa'i me zhes pa bzhin dang*/ de dag 'grub pa nyer len la rag lus pa'i phyir na'ang yin te/ rgyal po la ltos pa'i mi la rgyal po'i mi zhes pa bzhin dang*/ yang zag bcas de dag las nyon mongs pa rnams 'byung bas kyang yin te/ sman dang me tog 'byung ba'i shing la sman gyi shing dang*/ me tog gi shing zhes pa lta bu'o/ / zag bcas de dag la 'thab bcas zhes kyang bstan te/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyis g.yul 'gyed pa ltar nyon mongs pa rnams ni rang gzhan la gnod pa'i phyir 'thab pa yin la/ bcas zhes pa rgyas pa'i don te/ 'thab pa des nyer len gyi phung po rnams rgyas par byas pa'i phyir/ dper na zag pa rnams rgyas pa la zag bcas zhes pa bzhin no//sdug bsngal yin te/ zag bcas kyi phung po de dag la sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs par 'brel te 'phags pa rnams kyis rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i phyir dang*/ kun 'byung ste/ 'di las sdug bsngal phyi ma kun 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ 'jig rten ces pa ste/ de dag rang gi ngo skal dang gtso bor gnyen pos 'jig pa'i rten du dang*/ lta gnas te/ de dag nyid la 'jig lta sogs kyis dmigs shing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gnas sam yul yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yang de dag snga ma snga ma rgyu dang*/ phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bu'i tshul du rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba'i phyir/ srid pa zhes pa'ang zag bcas kyi phung po de dag gi rnam grangs yin no//gnyis pa phung khams skye mched kyi rnam bzhag la bzhi/ phung khams skye mched so so'i rang bzhin/ sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan/ chos gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa/ chos gsum gyi go rim mo/

/dang po la gsum/ rgyas par bshad pa/ bsdus te bstan pa/ dogs pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gzugs kyi phung sogs dang*/ tshor sogs gsum gyi dang*/ rnam shes kyi de bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ bstan pa/ bshad pa/ khams dang skye mched du 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid//ces pa ste/ gzugs kyi phung po de ni dbye na bcu gcig tu yod de/ mig sogs dbang po lnga dang*/ gzugs sogs don lnga dang*/ rnam par rig byed min pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/ nyid kyi sgra ni gzhan ldan rnams bcad de/ bcu gcig po de las gzhan pa'i gzugs med ces pa'o//gnyis pa bshad pa la gsum/ dbang po lnga/ don lnga/ rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de dag rnams kyi rnam shes rten/ /mig la sogs gzugs dang ba rnams// ¿9¿ zhes pa ste/ don lnga po de dag rnams kyi yul can gyi rnam par shes pa skye ba'i rten dbang po rnams ni mig dang*/ la sogs pas rna ba sna lce lus te nang gi gzugs dang ba rnams yin zhing*/ de dag gi dbyibs kyang rim pa ltar zar ma'i me tog dang*/ gro ga gcus pa dang*/ zangs khab gshibs pa dang*/ zla ba bkas pa dang*/ bya reg 'jam gyi spu lta bu yod par 'dod/ de la zla ba bkas pa ni lce'i g.yas g.yon gnyis la dbang pos khyab pa dang*/ bya reg 'jam gyi spus lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab pa ltar lus dbang gis kyang de ltar khyab par bshad/ gnyis pa don lnga la lnga/ dang po ni/ gzugs rnam gnyis dang rnam nyi shu//zhes pa ste/ mig gi yul gyi gzugs kyi skye mched gang zhig /bsdu na kha dog gi gzugs dang*/ dbyibs kyi gzugs rnam pa gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyas par phye na dang po la bcu gnyis dang*/ phyi ma la brgyad de rnam pa nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtsa ba'i kha dog sngo ser dmar dkar bzhi/ yan lag gi kha dog/

snang ba/ mun pa/ sprin/ du ba/ rdul/ khug rna/ nyi ma/ grib ma ste brgyad dang bcu gnyis/ phyi ma la ring po/ thung ngu*/ lham pa/ zlum po/ mtho ba/ dma' ba/ phya le ba/ phya le ba ma yin pa dang brgyad do//de dag las snang ba ni nyi zla nor bu me 'od sogs kyis snang ba dang*/ khug rna ni lho bur/ nyi ma ni nyi 'od kyis khyab pa'i dngos po/ grib ma ni nyi grib dang gzugs brnyan sogs kyang ngo*/ /lham pa ni gru bzhi/ phya le yin min ni sa cha sogs ngos mnyam mi mnyam mo//gnyis pa sgra ni/ sgra ni rnam pa brgyad yod de//zhes pa ste/ sgra'i skye mched ni rtsa ba'i dbye ba zin pa'i 'byung ba dang*/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gnyis las/ dang po la sems can du ston mi ston gnyis/ ston pa la snyan mi snyan gnyis/ mi ston pa la'ang snyan mi snyan gnyis te bzhi dang*/ de bzhin du phyi ma la'ang sems can du ston mi ston gnyis/ de re re la'ang snyan mi snyan gnyis te bzhi dang rnam pa brgyad yod de/ de dag gi mtshan gzhi ni rim pa bzhin dang po ni/ chos smra ba'am glu len pa dang*/ spyo tshig dang*/ khu byug gi skad dang*/ gcan gzan gyi nga ro'o/ /phyi ma ni sprul pas glu len pa dang*/ des spyo ba dang*/ rlung gis bskul ba'i dril bu'i sgra dang brag ral ba'i sgra lta bu rnams so//gsum pa ro la/ ro ni rnam drug *//ces pa ste/ ro'i skye mched ni rnam pa drug ste/ mngar ba/ skyur ba/ lan tshwa/ tsha ba/ kha ba/ bska ba'o/ /de dag ni rim bzhin ka ra/ skyu ru ra/ lan tshwa/ pi pi ling*/ tig ta/ a ru ra'i ro lta bu'o//bzhi pa dri la/ dri rnam bzhi//zhes pa ste/ dri'i skye mched ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ dri zhim pa dang*/ nga ba gnyis/ de re rer mnyam mi mnyam gnyis te bzhi'o/ /mnyam pa sbyar byung dang*/ mi mnyam pa lhan skyes la 'dod/lnga pa reg bya la/reg bya bcu gcig bdag nyid do//

¿10¿ zhes pa ste/ reg bya'i skye mched ni bcu gcig yod de/ rgyu'i reg bya 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras bu'i reg bya 'jam rtsub lci yang grang bkres skom pa bdun gyi bdag nyid do/ / phyi ma gsum ni rim pa ltar dro ba dang zas dang btung ba rnams 'dod par byed pa'o//gsum pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ de'i rgyu 'byung ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ g.yengs dang sems med pa yi yang*/ /dge dang mi dge rjes 'brel gang*//'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa/ /de ni rnam rig byed min brjod// ¿11¿ ces pa ste/ rig min gyi gzugs gang zhig /khyad chos bzhi ldan du yod de/ gnas skabs kyi khyad par rang kun nas slong byed las sems gzhan du g.yeng ba dang*/ sems med pa yi snyoms 'jug gnyis kyi gnas skabs su'ang yod pa/ yang sgras ma yengs pa sems dang ldan pa'i gnas skabs su'ang yod pa dang*/ ngo bo'i khyad par dge ba dang mi dge ba gang rung dang*/ dus kyi khyad par rang gtong byed ma byung bar snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyun rjes su 'brel ba gang dang*/ rgyu'i khyad par lus sems kyi tshogs pa'i 'byung ba chen po rnams rgyur byas pa'i 'bras gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ de'i nges tshig ni/ gzugs dang byed pa'i rang bzhin yin yang rnam par rig byed bzhin du kun slong gzhan gyis go zhing rig par byed pa ma yin pas rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs su brjod do zhes slob dpon rang gi bzhed pa ston to//gnyis pa de'i rgyu 'byung ba bshad pa la bzhi/ dbye ba/ byed las/ mtshan nyid/ dogs gcod do/ /dang po ni/ 'byung ba dag ni sa khams dang*/ /chu dang me dang rlung khams rnams//zhes pa ste/ 'byung ba dag ni sa'i khams dang*/ chu'i khams dang*/ me'i khams dang*/ rlung gi khams rnams yin te/ 'di la 'bras gzugs sna tshogs 'byung bas 'byung ba dang*/ 'bras gzugs thams cad kyi rten yin pas na chen po dang*/

'byung ba rang rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pas sam yang na rgyur byas pa'i sgo nas 'bras gzugs rnams 'dzin pa'i phyir khams zhes brjod do//gnyis pa byed las ni/ 'dzin pa la sogs las su grub//ces pa ste/ 'bras gzugs rnams sa khams kyis mi ltung bar 'dzin pa dang*/ la sogs pas chus mi 'thor bar sdud pa dang*/ mes ma rul bar smin pa dang*/ rlung gis 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa rnams 'byung ba de dag gi las su grub bo//gsum pa mtshan nyid ni/ sra gsher dro nyid g.yo ba rnams// ¿12¿ zhes pa ste/ sra zhing 'thas pa sa dang rlan zhing gsher ba chu dang*/ tsha zhing sreg pa'am dro ba nyid me dang*/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung ste khams rnams so so'i mtshan nyid do//bzhi pa dogs gcod ni/ 'jig rten gyi ni tha snyad du/ /kha dog dbyibs la sa zhes brjod//chu me yang ngo rlung tshogs khams/ /nyid yin de dang 'dra ba'ang yin// ¿13¿ ces pa ste/ gsung rab rnams las sa'i khams dang sa zhes gsungs na de dag khyad par yod dam ce na/ dang po la ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid rnams tshang dgos la/ phyi ma ni/ 'jig rten gyi ni tha snyad du kha dog dang dbyibs la sa zhes brjod de/ dper na sa dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ zlum po zhes pa lta bu dang*/ chu me yang ngo ste/ sa la ji lta ba bzhin du chu me gnyis kyang kha dog dang dbyibs la brjod/ rlung tshogs ni khams g.yo ba'i reg bya nyid la 'jig rten na'ang rlung yin par 'dod/ lus la rlung gis reg go zhes dang*/ yang na sa sogs de dang 'dra bar kha dog dang dbyibs la 'dod pa'ang yin te/ rlung sngon po dang zlum po zhes brjod pa lta bu'o//gsum pa khams dang skye mched du 'jog tshul ni/ dbang don de dag kho na la/ /skye mched dang ni khams bcur 'dod//ces pa ste/ slob dpon ni gzhung zor yangs pa la mkhas pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa'i dbang po lnga dang*/ don lnga po de dag kho na la skye mched 'jog pa na gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu dang ni khams 'jog pa na gzugs can gyi khams bcur 'dod de/

kho na'i sgras rig min gyi gzugs bcad pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa tshor sogs gsum gyi bshad pa la gnyis/ phung po bar pa gsum gyi ngo bo/ de las khams skye 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ tshor ba myong ba'o 'du shes ni/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid do//

¿14¿ 'du byed phung po bzhi las gzhan//ces pa ste/ tshor ba'i phung po ni/ bde sdug bar ma'i rang bzhin yul dang mthun par rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba dang*/ de'ang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na bde sdug btang snyoms yid bde yid mi bde ba lnga dang*/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye na mig sogs drug go/'du shes kyi phung po ni/ rnam pa yul gyi spu ris so sor phye nas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid do/ /dbye na don la mtshan mar 'dzin pa sngon po ser po sogs dang*/ tha snyad la mtshan mar 'dzin pa skyes pa dang bud med sogs 'dzin pa dang gnyis so// rten gyis dbye na mig sogs drug go/'du byed kyi phung po ni/ gzugs tshor ba 'du shes rnam shes te phung po bzhi las rdzas gzhan pa'i 'dus byas rnams yin la/ dbye na mtshungs ldan gyi 'du byed dang*/ ldan min 'du byed gnyis so//gnyis pa de las khams skye 'jog tshul ni/ de gsum rnam rig byed min dang*//'dus ma byas rnams bcas pa ni/ /chos kyi skye mched khams zhes bya// ¿15¿ zhes pa ste/ tshor 'du 'du byed de gsum dang*/ rnam par rig byed min gzugs dang*/ 'dus ma byas gsum po rnams dang bcas pa'i rdzas bdun po de ni skye mched 'jog pa na chos kyi skye mched dang*/ khams 'jog pa na chos kyi khams zhes bya'o//gsum pa rnam shes kyi de bshad pa la gsum/ rnam shes kyi ngo bo/ khams skyer 'jog pa/ yid khams bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam shes so sor rnam rig pa//zhes pa ste/ rnam shes kyi phung po ni rnam pa rang stobs kyis mig sogs shes pa rang rang gis gzugs sogs don tsam so sor rnam par rig pa'o//dbye na mig sogs drug go /rang stobs zhes pas sems byung dang*/ rig pa zhes pas shes bya'i gzhi gzhan gsum rnam bcad du bshad/ gnyis pa khams skyer 'jog pa ni/ yid kyi skye mched kyang de yin//khams bdun dag tu'ang 'dod pa ste/

/rnam par shes pa drug dang yid// ¿16¿ces pa ste/ skye mched du bzhag na yid kyi skye mched kyang rnam shes tshogs drug po de yin la/ khams 'jog pa na sems kyi khams bdun dag tu'ang 'dod pa yin te/ bshad ma thag pa'i rnam par shes pa drug dang*/ yid khams dang*/ bdun du 'dod pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa yid khams bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba/ de'i sgrub byed do/ /dang po ni/ drug po 'das ma thag pa yi/ /rnam shes gang yin de yid do//zhes pa ste/ rnam shes tshogs drug po 'das ma thag pa yi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa yid shes skye ba'i rten byed pa de yid kyi khams yin te/ rnam shes drug las rdzas tha dad pa med pa'i phyir/ 'das ma thag ces pas dus gzhan gyis bar chod kyang shes pa gzhan gyis ma chod na yid khams su 'dod de/ 'gog snyoms kyi 'jug sems de ldang sems kyi rten du rung ba bzhin no//gnyis pa de'i sgrub byed ni/ drug pa'i rten ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /khams ni bco brgyad dag tu 'dod// ¿17¿ zhes pa ste/ rnam shes drug dang yid khams rnams gcig gis gcig bsdus pa'i phyir/ rdzas su bcu gnyis sam bcu bdun du 'gyur ro zhe na/ rnam shes dang po lnga la rten dbang po re yod la/ yid shes la rten gzhan med pas des na rnam shes drug las 'das da lta cha gnyis su bye ba'i 'das pa des drug pa yid shes kyi rten ni rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na 'dir mtshan nyid kyi dbang du na rten dbang po drug/ brten pa rnam shes drug /dmigs pa yul drug ste khams ni bco brgyad dag tu 'dod do//gnyis pa bsdus te bstan pa la gnyis/ bsdu ba dngos/ bsdu tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ phung po dang ni skye mched dang*/ /khams gcig gis ni thams cad bsdus//zhes pa ste/ phung po lnga dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis dang*/ khams bco brgyad des 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad bsdus kyang de las grangs nyung bas bsdus pa yod dam ce na/

yod de/ gzugs kyi phung po dang ni yid kyi skye mched dang*/ khams gcig gis te chos kyi khams kyis ni chos thams cad bsdus te/ dang pos gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu dang khams bcuu dang rig min gyi gzugs rnams bsdus/ gnyis pas sems khams bdun dang rnam shes kyi phung po bsdus/ gsum pas tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po dang chos kyi skye mched/ rig byed min pa'ang bsdus pa yin no//gnyis pa bsdu tshul ni/ rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis te/ /gzhan gyi dngos dang mi ldan phyir// ¿18¿ ces pa ste/ bsdu bya de dag sdud byed rang gi ngo bo'i mtshan nyid yin pa nyid kyis rang gis rang bsdus pa yin te/ de las rdzas gzhan gyi dngos po dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ bsdu ba bzhis 'khor bzhi bsdus pa ltar gzhan gyis gzhan bsdus pa'i bsdu ba btags pa ba ma yin no//gsum pa dogs pa bcad pa ni/ mig la sogs pa gnyis mod kyi/ /rigs dang spyod yul rnam par shes//'dra ba'i phyir na khams gcig nyid/ /mdzes bya'i phyir na gnyis byung ngo*// ¿19¿ zhes pa ste/ khams bco brgyad du ma nges so/ /mig sogs gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ mig dang la sogs pas rna ba sna rnams gnyis gnyis yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang mig gnyis ni mig tsam du rigs 'dra ba dang*/ spyod yul gzugs gcig la byed pa 'dra ba dang*/ rang 'bras mig gi rnam par shes pa gcig bskyed pa 'dra ba'i phyir/ des na khams gcig nyid du grub bo/ /'on te gnyis yod pa la dgos pa yod de/ rten mdzes par bya ba'i phyir na mig sogs gnyis gnyis byung ngo*/ /de rnams ya gcig las med na shin tu mi mdzes par byed do//gnyis pa sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spungs dang skye sgo rigs kyi don/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams yin//ces pa ste/ gzugs sogs ris mthun du ma gcig tu spungs pa dang*/ gang la brten nas sems sems byung rnams skye zhing mched pa ste rgyas pa'i sgor gyur pa dang*/

rang 'bras phyi ma rnams snga ma'i rigs 'dra 'dzin pa nyid kyi don te/ go rim bzhin phung po dang*/ skye mched dang*/ khams rnams kyi sgra don yin no//gsum pa chos gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa la gsum/ dngos dang*/ tshor 'du logs su bstan pa'i dgos pa/ 'dus ma byas phung por ma bstan pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ rmongs dbang 'dod rnam gsum gyi phyir//phung po la sogs gsum bstan to// ¿20¿ zhes pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phung skye khams gsum bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ sems byung dang*/ gzugs can dang*/ gzugs sems gnyis ka la ril po'i bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa gsum bzlog pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang po rno 'bring brtul po gsum gyi phyir dang*/ gdul bya tshig bsdus 'bring rgyas pa don du gnyer ba'i 'dod pa rnam pa gsum gyi phyir phung po dang*/ la sogs pas skye mched dang*/ khams gsum du bstan pa'o//gnyis pa tshor 'du logs su bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa dang*//'khor ba'i rgyu phyir rim rgyu'i phyir//sems byung rnams las tshor ba dang*//'du shes logs shig phung por bzhag/ ¿21¿ ces pa ste/ ci'i phyir 'du byed las tshor 'du gnyis logs su bzhag ce na/ de ni khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba dag gi rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pas kyang bzhag ste/ khyim pa rnams ni tshor ba la rtsod de/ 'dod pa sogs kyi rgyus rgyal pos rgyal po dang*/ zhing pas zhing pa dang/ khyim pas khyim pa la rtsod pa dang*/ rab byung dag ni 'du shes la rtsod de lta ba la lhag par zhen nas rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' sgrub pa dang sun 'byin pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo'ang yin te/ tshor ba'i dbang gis 'ching ba gsum zhes dang*/ gtsang bde rtag bdag ni 'du shes phyin ci log bzhis nyon mongs thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir dang*/ 'chad 'gyur phung lnga'i go rim ston pa'i rgyu'i ched du'ang yin pa'i phyir/

des na sems byung 'du byed kyi phung po rnams las tshor ba dang 'du shes logs shig tu phung por bzhag pa yin no//gsum pa 'dus ma byas phung por ma bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/phung po dag tu 'dus ma byas/ /don du mi rung phyir ma bshad//ces pa ste/ 'dus ma byas khams skyer 'jog la phung po dag tu ma bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dus ma byas la dus kyi dbye ba med pa dang*/ gzugs nas rnam shes bar gyi ngo bo mi rung ba dang*/ phung po'i don du ma spungs pa la 'dod na/ de'ang der mi rung ba dang*/ yang na kun byang gi gzhi shes pa'i ched du phung lnga ston pa yin na/ de ni de gnyis ka'i rgyu min pa'i phyir ma bshad do//bzhi pa chos gsum gyi go rim la gsum/ phung lnga'i go rim/ khams skye'i go rim/ dogs pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rim ni rags dang kun nyon mongs/ /snod sogs don khams ji bzhin no// ¿22¿ zhes pa ste/ gzugs sogs phung lnga'i go rim ni/ rags phra'i dbang du dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa skye rim dang*/ snod sogs kyi don dang*/ khams gsum gyi dbang du byas nas ji bzhin du bzhag pa yin no//dang po gzugs ni/ thogs bcas yin pa'i phyir phyi ma kun las rags pas dang por bstan/ bdag gi rkang pa dang lag pas tshor ro zhes tha snyad rtogs sla bas tshor ba dang*/ mtshan mar yongs su gcod pas 'du shes dang*/ chags pa sogs sems kyi rtsol ba yin pas 'du byed dang*/ don gyi ngo bo tsam rig pas shin tu phra ba'i phyir rnam shes te snga ma rnams rags pa dang phyi ma phyi ma phra ba'i phyir dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gzod ma nas pho mo rnams gzugs la brten nas dga' ba skye/ de yang tshor ba de myong 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ de yang phyin ci log gi 'du shes su gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ de yang chags sdang gi rtog pa 'du byed las 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ de dag gis rnam shes kyang nyon mongs can du byas pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa ni/ zas la spyod pa ltar tshor ba'i rten byed pa'i phyir gzugs snod/ tshor ba zas/ 'du shes lan tshwa/ 'du byed byin po/ rnam shes za ba po lta bu'i phyir dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ 'dod pa rnams gzugs dang*/ gzugs khams gzhi tshor ba dang*/ gzugs med 'og ma gsum 'du shes dang*/ srid rtse 'du byed kyis rab tu dbye ba dang*/ rnam shes ni sa bon ltar de dag la brten nas gnas pa'i phyir mthar bstan to//gnyis pa khams skye'i go rim ni/ da lta'i don phyir dang po lnga/ /'byung ba las gyur don phyir bzhi//gzhan ni ches ring myur 'jug phyir/ /yang na ji ltar gnas bzhin rim// ¿23¿ zhes pa ste/ da lta ba'i yul gyi don la 'jug pa'i phyir dang po mig sogs lnga bstan nas/ yid ni dus gsum dang dus kyis ma bsdus pa 'dus ma byas la'ang 'jug pa'i phyir rjes su bstan to/ /lnga po de dag las kyang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i don gzugs sogs bzhi'i yul can yin pa'i phyir mig sogs bzhi dang po bstan la/ lus ni 'byung ba 'byung gyur gnyis ka'i yul can yin pas rjes su bstan pa dang*/ bzhi po de las gzhan mig dang rna ba gnyis ni yul ches ring ba la 'jug pa'i phyir dang po bstan te/ de las kyang rna ba bas mig ches ring ba la 'jug te/ thag ring po'i chu klung gi gzugs mthong yang sgra mi thos pa bzhin no zhes bshad/ sna lce gnyis las sna yul la myur bar 'jug pa'i phyir dang po bstan te/ lces ro ma myong bar snas dri tshor ba'i phyir/ yang na dbang rten rnams ji ltar mtho dman du gnas pa bzhin du de dag gi rim pa bstan to/ /des rten dbang po drug gi go rim grub pas brten pa rnam shes dang dmigs pa yul drug gi rim pa'ang grub bo/ /rgyal po drug gi gral rim grub pa dang btsun mo sras rnams kyang grub pa bzhin no//gsum pa dogs pa bcad pa ni/ bye brag don dang gtso bo'i phyir/

/chos mang ba dang mchog bsdus phyir//gcig ni gzugs kyi skye mched dang*/ /gcig ni chos zhes bya bar brjod// ¿24¿ ces pa ste/ gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu las mig yul kho na la gzugs zhes brjod pa dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis las yid yul kho na la chos kyi skye mched brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod do/ /gzugs can gyi skye mched gzhan dgu la ming re re yod kyang mig yul gyi skye mched 'di la ming gzhan med pas gzugs zhes brjod na spyi'i sgra des bye brag gi don mig yul kho na rtogs nus pa'i phyir dang*/ mig yul gyi gzugs ni gzugs can gzhan thams cad las rags shing gtso bo yin pa dang*/ 'di ni 'di na'o zhes bstan du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dag gzugs ni rnam pa nyi shu'i rags pa dang*/ shes rab dang lha dang sha'i mig gsum gyi yul yin pa'i phyir ro zhes kyang 'dod/ yang*/ chos kyi skye mched kyis ni tshor sogs chos mang po rnams bsdu ba dang*/ chos kyi mchog myang 'das so sor brtags 'gog kyang bsdus pa'i phyir/ snga ma mig gi yul gcig pu ni gzugs kyi skye mched dang*/ phyi ma yid kyi yul gcig pu ni chos kyi skye mched zhes bya bar brjod pa yin no//gsum pa chos gsum gyis thams cad bsdus par bstan pa la gsum/ chos kyi phung po bsdu tshul/ phung skye khams gzhan bsdu ba/ khams gnyis kyi ngo bo bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ de'i tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang rnams thub pas gsungs de dag/tshig gam ming yin de dag ni/ /gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus// ¿25¿ zhes pa ste/ 'dir ma bshad pa mdo las/ chos kyi phung po sogs gzhan yang bshad na de dag gang du 'du zhe na/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag gang yin pa rnams thub pas gsungs pa de dag ni mdo sde pa ltar na rna ba'i yul gyi rnam par rig byed kyi tshig gam sgra dang*/

bye smras yid yul du gyur pa'i ming gi rang bzhin du 'dod pa yin te/ de dag kyang snga ma ltar na gzugs phung dang*/ phyi ma ltar na 'du byed phung por dag tu 'dus so//gnyis pa de'i tshad bshad pa ni/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer/ /phung po la sogs gtam re yin//spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// ¿26¿ zhes pa ste/ 'o na chos phung re re la tshad ji tsam yod ce na/ sde pa kha cig ni shā ri'i bus bsdus pa chos kyi phung po zhes pa'i bstan bcos la shlo ka drug stong yod pas de dang tshad mnyam ces zer/ yang*/ gzhan dag ni phung po skye mched khams la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud re rdzogs par ston pa yin gyi tshigs bcad kyi grangs nges med par 'dod/ slob dpon rang lugs ni sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i spyod pa chags sogs tha dad pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni chos kyi phung po'ang grangs de dang mthun par brgyad khrir gsungs so//gnyis pa phung skye khams gzhan bsdu ba ni/ de bzhin gzhan yang ci rigs pa/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams ni//rang gi mtshan nyid legs dpyad de/ /ji skad bshad par bsdu bar bya// ¿27¿ zhes pa ste/ chos phung brgyad khrir phung lngar bsdus pa de bzhin du gzhan gang mdo las ci rigs par 'byung ba'i phung po skye mched khams kyi ming can rnams ni rang rang gi mtshan nyid legs par dpyad de sngar ji skad bshad pa'i chos gsum du bsdu bar bya'o//de'ang tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po lnga las dang po gzugs dang*/ lhag ma rnams 'du byed kyi phung por dang*/ phyi ma gnyis kyang mos pa dang shes rab kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ zad par bcu las dang po brgyad ma chags pa yin pas chos skye dang*/ 'khor dang bcas na phung po lnga yin pas yid chos gnyis su dang*/

zil gnon brgyad kyang sngar ltar yid chos gnyis dang*/ zad par nam mkha' rnam shes gnyis dang*/ gzugs med kyi skye mched bzhi yang phung po bzhi pa yin pas yid chos gnyis dang*/ de bzhin du khams mang po'i mdo las 'byung ba'i khams re gnyis kyi sdom ni/ mig sogs khams ni bco brgyad dang*/ /'byung bzhi nam mkha' rnam shes

dang*/ /tshor ba lnga dang ma rig pa/ /'dod khams gnod sems rnam par 'tshe/ /nges 'byung gnod sems med pa dang*/ /rnam mi 'tshe ste drug tshan gsum/ /gzugs ma gtogs pa'i phung po bzhi/ /'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med khams/ /ngan pa bar ma gya nom khams/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'gog pa'i khams/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /slob dang mi slob gnyi ga min/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar te/ /de ltar na ni gsum tshan drug /zag bcas zag pa med khams dang*/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas khams te/ khams ni drug cu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes so//gsum pa khams gnyis kyi ngo bo bshad pa la gnyis/ nam mkha' dang*/ rnam shes so/ /dang po ni/ bu ga nam mkha'i khams zhes bya/ /snang dang mun pa dag yin lo// zhes pa ste/ 'dir bstan gyi mkha' khams de nam mkha' dang mtshan nyid gcig tu 'dod dam ce na/ sgo skar khung kha sna'i buu ga sogs nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ste/ rgyu mtshan nyin mo snang ba dang*/ mtshan mo mun pa'i rang bzhin du phal cher gnas pa dag yin te/ rang gi ngo bo gnod pa byar rung ba'i thogs bcas dang*/ thogs bcas gzhan gyi nye 'khor du'ang 'byung ba'i phyir thogs bcas nye 'khor ba zhes dang*/ lo ni mdo sde pa ma rangs pa'i tshig yin te/ des ni nam mkha' nyid khams su'ang 'dod do//gnyis pa rnam shes ni/ zag dang bcas pa'i rnam shes ni/ /rnam shes khams yin skye ba'i rten// ¿28¿ ces pa ste/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rnam shes ni rnam shes kyi khams yin te/ des srid par skye ba'i rten nam gzhi byed pa'i phyir/ zag med kyis srid pa gcod pa'i phyir/ rnam shes kyi khams su mi rung ngo*//bzhi pa khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye la bdun/ gnyis tshan/ gsum tshan/ bcas ma bcas/ gzugs can gyi dbye ba/ byung ba gsum/ thob pa'i khyad par/ phyi nang la sogs pa'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bstan yod 'dir ni gzugs gcig pu//thogs dang bcas pa gzugs can bcu//zhes pa ste/

'di ni 'di na'o/ /de ni ga ge mo zhig na'o/ /des gzhan la bstan du yod pa ni khams bco brgyad po las 'dir gcig tu nges pa ni gzugs khams nyid yin te/ gcig pa'i sgras lhag ma bcu bdun bcad do//yang thogs pa dang bcas pa ni gzugs can gyi khams bcu yin te/ rang gi go sar gzugs can gzhan 'byung ba la gegs byed pa'i phyir/ spyir thogs pa la/ sgrib thogs/ yul thogs/ dmigs thogs gsum las/ dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ yul thogs ni/ mig sogs rang rang gi yul la thogs pa dang*/ dmigs thogs ni/ sems sems byung rnams sngon po lta bu gcig la dmigs na de la thogs nas gzhan la dmigs pa'i gegs byed pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa gsum tshan ni/ lung ma bstan brgyad de dag nyid//gzugs sgra ma gtogs gzhan rnam gsum// ¿29¿ 'dod khams gtogs pa thams cad do//gzugs kyi khams na bcu bzhi'o//dri dang ro dang sna dang ni//lce yi rnam shes khams ma gtogs// ¿30¿ gzugs med gtogs pa yid dang ni//chos dang yid kyi rnam shes khams//zhes pa ste/ khams bco brgyad dag las mtha' gcig tu lung du ma bstan pa ni brgyad yod de/ thogs bcas su bshad pa de dag nyid las gzugs sgra gnyis ma gtogs pa'i dbang po lnga dang dri ro reg bya'i khams rnams yin no/ /khams gzhan bcu po rnams ni dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum ka yod par 'dod/ de'ang yin te lus kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ ngag gis sangs rgyas la bstod pa rnams dge ba dang*/ mtshon bsnun pa dang*/ rdzun smra ba rnams mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ yang bco brgyad po de dag las khams gsum so sor gtogs pa du zhe na/ 'dod khams su gtogs pa bco brgyad po thams cad do/ /'dod spyod kyi sred pas de thams cad bdag gir byas pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs kyi khams na yod pa bcu bzhi'o/ khams zas la 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams der skyes pa'i phyir/

de na khams zas med la/ des na yul dri dang ro dang*/ yul can sna dang ni lce yi rnam shes kyi khams ma gtogs pa'i lhag ma rnams yod de/ 'o na reg bya dang*/ lce'i dbang po gnyis kyang med dam zhe na/ kham zas las gyur pa'i reg bya med kyang*/ dbang po'i rten byed pa'i 'byung ba dang gos bgo ba sogs yod pa'i phyir reg bya dang*/ rten mdzes pa dang gzugs la sred pa dang ma bral ba'i phyir sna lce'i dbang po gnyis bcas yod par 'dod/ gzugs med par gtogs pa la yid dang ni chos dang yid kyi rnam shes kyi khams gsum las gzhan rnams med de/ gzugs la sred pa dang bral bas gzugs can gyi khams bcu dang*/ des na de la brten pa'i rnam shes lnga yang med do//gsum pa bcas ma bcas kyi rab dbye ni/ de gsum zag bcas zag pa med/ /lhag ma rnams ni zag bcas so// ¿31¿ rtog dang dpyod dang bcas pa ni/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams lnga yin//tha ma gsum ni rnam gsum mo/ /lhag ma rnams ni gnyis ka spangs// ¿32¿ nges par rtog dang rjes dran pa'i/ /rnam par rtog pas rnam mi rtog/de dag yid kyi shes rab g.yeng*/ /yid kyi dran pa thams cad nyid// ¿33¿ dmigs bcas sems kyi khams bdun no/ /chos kyi phyed kyang *// zhes pa ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i khams tha ma de gsum la sdug kun gyis bsdus pa zag bcas dang*/ lam bden dang 'dus ma byas kyis bsdus pa rnams zag pa med pa ste/ lhag ma khams bco lnga po rnams ni mtha' gcig tu zag bcas so/ /mnyam bzhag gi sa pa min pa dang*/ sgom spang yin pa dang*/ zag pa rnams rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//yang*/ grogs rtog pa dang bcas la dpyod pa dang bcas pa ni mig sogs rnam par shes pa'i khams lnga yin te/ kha phyir bltas shing sems byung rtsing zhib dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sa pa yin pa'i phyir/ khams tha ma yid chos yid shes gsum ni rtog bcas dpyod bcas dang*/ rtog med dpyod tsam dang*/
